name: JSON to CSV API
shortDescription: Deterministic JSON-array to CSV conversion with nested flattening and type inference for data agents
description: Agent-native JSON-to-CSV conversion computed in real code (not by a language model). /convert turns a JSON object or array of objects into RFC 4180 CSV, flattening nested objects with dot-notation keys, serializing arrays as JSON, unioning columns across rows, and quoting values that contain delimiters, quotes, or newlines. Configurable delimiter, header, and flattening. The one-call /lookup adds per-column type inference (string/number/boolean/json/null/mixed), a reasoning object, and prioritized recommendations. Handles up to 10,000 rows. Confidence is always 1.0 because nothing is estimated.
